Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (user skill)

This repo has no README or `package.json`, so nothing else is strictly required. If you add them later:

Skip these unless you ask for them; scope stays limited to the LICENSE file only.

### 3. Stage and commit (only if you ask)

Per your preferences, commit only when requested. When you do:

```bash
git add LICENSE
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add MIT license.

EOF
)"
```

Then verify with `git status`.

## Verification checklist

- [ ] `LICENSE` exists at repo root with correct filename (case-sensitive on some systems)
- [ ] Copyright year and holder are correct
- [ ] Full license text is unmodified official wording (for standard licenses)
- [ ] File is tracked by git after add/commit

## Scope boundaries

- **In scope:** Create root `LICENSE` with chosen license text
- **Out of scope:** README updates, package metadata, legal review, or choosing license on your behalf without confirmation

flowchart LR

  create --> verify[Verify text and filename]
  verify --> commit[Commit if requested]
```
